g.text: Phone-conditioned visual response across the saved 17-lag grid

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4b5963

g.text: Median across supported speakers; faint curves show individual RMS speaker trajectories. Vertical 0 = original clock.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #34424c

g.text: Per-utterance p varies; no common p or single response peak is selected. Curves use saved row-standardized values without lag-wise restandardization.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #34424c

g.text: RMS Cₚ and Hₚ descriptive gates: all six model × attribute cells pass (as recorded in ROOT QA).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #66737c

g.text: Exploratory functional response only; no best-lag, causal-accuracy, or real-mouth accuracy claim.
